name: wechat-work-bridge
description: Isolated no-model bridge between a WeChat account authorized through ClawBot QR login and one ChatGPT Work reply automation.

interface.shortDescription: 微信 ClawBot 与 Work 对话桥接
interface.longDescription: No-model transport for a WeChat account authorized through ClawBot QR login. It emits text and image events, exposes read-only pending-message and image tools, serializes delivery until a reply receipt exists, and provides an idempotent reply tool bound to the originating sender.
interface.defaultPrompt: 把此自动化作为已扫码授权 ClawBot 的微信号的唯一回复执行者，处理新消息并使用事件绑定的幂等工具发送一次回复。
